grading_notes.method: 9 of 11 assertions checked purely by file inspection, git history, and post-hoc command execution against the live fixture; assertions 2 and 11 read the agent's final report text.
judge_bias_caveats: Assertions 2 and 11 rely partly on the agent's self-reported narrative; self-reports proved unreliable elsewhere in this iteration (counts in this arm's report disagree with its own committed verification log: 7 vs 6 tests, 11 vs ~8 tool rounds), so both judged assertions were anchored to committed artifacts (untouched FEAT-002 file; in-ticket verification log) rather than the narrative alone.
Standard caveats apply where narrative is weighed: verbosity bias (detailed reports read as more compliant) and self-preference (the grader model shares a family with the graded agents).
